name: The Good Place
description: Eleanor Shellstrop, an ordinary woman who, through an extraordinary string of events, enters the afterlife where she comes to realize that she hasn't been a very good person. With the help of her wise afterlife mentor, she's determined to shed her old way of living and discover the awesome (or at least the pretty good) person within.

videos.title: The Selection: The Mission (1)
videos.overview: Shawn and his demon cohorts plot to destroy Michael’s new neighborhood. Shawn gets the demons briefed on their mission.

videos.title: The Selection: The Candidates (2)
videos.overview: Shawn’s demon ding-dongs pitch their human choices for Michael’s new neighborhood.

videos.title: The Selection: The Takeout Order (3)
videos.overview: Shawn’s demon ash-holes try to decide what to eat. Maybe some sludge from the inside of shoes that you don’t wear socks with?

videos.title: The Selection: The Storm Out (4)
videos.overview: Tensions rise as the demons try to select the right “human fart bombs” for Michael’s new neighborhood. Glenn feels Shawn is being too mean.

videos.title: The Selection: The Talk (5)
videos.overview: In a demon-to-demon chat with Glenn, Shawn is inspired to rethink the way he forks with Michael’s new neighborhood.

videos.title: The Selection: The Solution (6)
videos.overview: When Shawn takes aim on a more personal attack on the humans, Glenn has some reservations.

videos.title: Series Finale Aftershow
videos.overview: Holy motherforking shirtballs - this really is the end! In this series finale aftershow the main cast of the Good Place reminisces about filming the last episode and how each of them feels about the show ending. They also give quite emotional toasts to each other.

videos.title: 2019 San Diego Comic-Con Panel
videos.overview: Marc Evan Jackson moderates a forking great conversation between stars Ted Danson, Kristen Bell, William Jackson Harper, D’Arcy Carden, Manny Jacinto and executive producers Michael Schur and Drew Goddard at the 2019 San Diego Comic-Con.

videos.title: Everything Is Fine
videos.overview: Newly-deceased Eleanor Shellstrop is sent to the Good Place, but only by mistake; Eleanor is determined to become a better person in her afterlife with help from friends Chidi and Janet; Eleanor tries to prove to Chidi that she's worthy of his help.

videos.title: Flying
videos.overview: Eleanor tries to prove to Chidi that she is worthy of his help. Meanwhile, Tahani and Jianyu try to help Michael feel better about the unknown flaw in his Neighborhood.

videos.title: Tahani Al-Jamil
videos.overview: Chidi begins formally teaching Eleanor about ethics, and lesson No. 1 is: be kind to your neighbor. Michael and Janet help Chidi find a new, exciting hobby.

videos.title: Jason Mendoza
videos.overview: Eleanor has a hard time remaining hidden.  Michael asks Tahani to assist a neighbor in finding her true purpose.

videos.title: Category 55 Emergency Doomsday Crisis
videos.overview: Eleanor's eagerness to learn ethics from Chidi becomes the full-time job he never wanted. Meanwhile, Michael and Janet focus their attention on a Neighborhood emergency.

videos.title: What We Owe to Each Other
videos.overview: Eleanor is enlisted to help Michael with an important task that could determine her fate in the Good Place. Meanwhile, Chidi agrees to be the third wheel in an effort to help out his friend.

videos.title: The Eternal Shriek
videos.overview: Eleanor puts Janet in her crosshairs to save Michael from eternal suffering.

videos.title: Most Improved Player
videos.overview: Michael has a private meeting with Eleanor, who is put to the test. Also, Chidi harbors a secret and mulls over what to do.

videos.title: ...Someone Like Me as a Member
videos.overview: Michael faces a challenge when he tries to resolve an unprecedented situation. In addition, Chidi makes a connection, to Eleanor's chagrin, and a different side of Janet emerges.

videos.title: Chidi's Choice
videos.overview: Eleanor makes a surprising personal discovery. Meanwhile, Michael tasks an indecisive Chidi with coming to an important decision and Jianyu makes a big announcement.

videos.title: What's My Motivation
videos.overview: Eleanor and Tahani hatch a plan while Michael makes a startling discovery. Meanwhile, Chidi confides in Eleanor after learning some interesting news.

videos.title: Mindy St. Claire
videos.overview: With the help of Chidi and Tahani, Michael faces his biggest challenge yet. Meanwhile, Eleanor, Jianyu and Janet are faced with a monumental decision.

videos.title: Michael's Gambit
videos.overview: Eleanor, Jason, Chidi and Tahani argue about which two of them should go to the Bad Place. Eleanor has a shocking realization about the Good Place.

videos.title: Everything Is Great!
videos.overview: Having had their memories erased by ambitious master architect Michael, Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason again settle into the Good Place, unaware of what has previously transpired...except that Eleanor discovers the one clue she had left for herself and attempts to piece things together.

videos.title: Dance Dance Resolution
videos.overview: Michael continues to work out the kinks in his grand plan. Meanwhile, Eleanor stumbles across a secret.

videos.title: Team Cockroach
videos.overview: Michael approaches things from a new angle. Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason struggle to make a collective decision.

videos.title: Existential Crisis
videos.overview: Tahani throws a dinner party to impress. Eleanor and Jason both have to lend a hand when things don't go as planned.

videos.title: The Trolley Problem
videos.overview: Chidi and Eleanor tackle a famous ethical dilemma, leading to a conflict with Michael. Meanwhile, Tahani harbors a secret and confides in Janet.

videos.title: Janet and Michael
videos.overview: When the Neighborhood experiences a small glitch, Michael has to resolve the issue with Janet before it gets out of control.

videos.title: Derek
videos.overview: Janet creates a big problem for Michael. Meanwhile, Eleanor lets Chidi  in on a secret, and Jason puts Tahani in a difficult position.

videos.title: Leap to Faith
videos.overview: Michael receives a surprise visitor. Meanwhile, Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason attempt to solve a riddle.

videos.title: Best Self
videos.overview: Michael finds himself in a bind. Meanwhile, Eleanor sparks an idea that has Chidi, Tahani, Jason and even Janet laying their feelings on the line.

videos.title: Rhonda, Diana, Jake, and Trent
videos.overview: Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani, Janet, and Jason head to a destination that may have lasting implications.

videos.title: The Burrito
videos.overview: Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani, and Jason consider just how much they have (or have not) improved. Michael is left to deal with the consequences of his recent actions.

videos.title: Somewhere Else
videos.overview: Michael makes a plea. Eleanor looks to take the high road. Michael tries to pull a rabbit out of a hat.

videos.title: Everything Is Bonzer!
videos.overview: Michael intervenes in the near-death accidents of Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason on Earth, in hopes that a second chance at life allows them to become better versions of themselves.

videos.title: The Brainy Bunch
videos.overview: Michael's grand scheme hits an unexpected snag and forces him to take drastic measures.

videos.title: The Snowplow
videos.overview: A surprising announcement from one of the humans threatens to dissolve the group.

videos.title: Jeremy Bearimy
videos.overview: The group explores the three main branches of ethical thought.

videos.title: The Ballad of Donkey Doug
videos.overview: Jason visits with some people from his past while Chidi gets help in resolving a problem.

videos.title: A Fractured Inheritance
videos.overview: Eleanor makes a startling discovery that tests her resolve, Tahani looks to make amends and Janet does some bonding.

videos.title: The Worst Possible Use of Free Will
videos.overview: Eleanor recalls some forgotten events from her past.

videos.title: Don't Let the Good Life Pass You By
videos.overview: Michael and Janet visit the person they believe to be the blueprint for how to live a good life on Earth; Eleanor turns to Tahani for advice.

videos.title: Janet(s)
videos.overview: While Eleanor and the gang contend with an intense out-of-body experience, Michael hatches a plan with Janet's help.

videos.title: The Book of Dougs
videos.overview: Michael's resolve is put to the test. Meanwhile, Jason wrestles with his feelings and Chidi surprises Eleanor.

videos.title: Chidi Sees the Time-Knife
videos.overview: Michael arranges an important meeting and Janet makes a reconnection.

videos.title: Pandemonium
videos.overview: Michael's crisis forces Eleanor to assume the title of the neighborhood architect. Tahani makes a discovery about the new humans.

videos.title: A Girl from Arizona (1)
videos.overview: With Eleanor assuming the role of the architect, the group adapts to the challenges facing them when four test subjects inhabit a new neighborhood under their supervision.

videos.title: A Girl from Arizona (2)
videos.overview: Eleanor, Michael, Janet and Tahani have their hands full when the new residents begin to show their true colors. Jason receives some unsettling news.

videos.title: Chillaxing
videos.overview: Michael and Eleanor discover something troubling and turn to an unusual source for help. Tahani lends her expertise to assist with one of the new residents.

videos.title: Tinker, Tailor, Demon, Spy
videos.overview: As the group deals with a frustrating lack of progress, a visitor arrives and makes a shocking claim that causes them to question who can be trusted.

videos.title: Employee of the Bearimy
videos.overview: Michael and Jason sneak into Demon-Con. Left in charge of the neighborhood, Eleanor copes with Derek's ineptitude and Tahani's dissatisfaction.

videos.title: A Chip Driver Mystery
videos.overview: After Brent writes an offensive book, Eleanor, Michael and the others try to help him evolve. One of the humans discovers Jason's true identity.

videos.title: Help Is Other People
videos.overview: With one day left in the year, Simone reveals that she's suspicious about the neighborhood -- and her investigation could derail the entire experiment.

videos.title: The Funeral to End All Funerals
videos.overview: As the Judge hears Michael and Shawn's arguments about the results of the experiment, Janet and the humans give each other the funerals they deserved.

videos.title: The Answer
videos.overview: With time running out to find answers, Chidi must sort through his life -- and afterlives -- before he can provide the help everyone needs.

videos.title: You've Changed, Man
videos.overview: The group scrambles to devise a new afterlife system that the Good and Bad Places can agree on before it's too late. Chidi has a newfound confidence.

videos.title: Mondays, Am I Right?
videos.overview: While the humans search for test candidates, Michael trains a group of architects. Eleanor doesn't want Chidi to learn too much about her past.

videos.title: Patty
videos.overview: Arriving at a new place, Michael receives an unexpected honor. Meanwhile, the rest of the group explores — and learns a shocking truth.

videos.title: Whenever You're Ready
videos.overview: Michael works with the Joint Council of Afterlife Affairs to smooth out kinks in the system. Jason and Tahani move on. Eleanor tries to influence Chidi.

awards: Nominated for 12 Primetime Emmys. 35 wins & 140 nominations total
